description: Secondary Substations (PTD) is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). Geographical location of the MT/LV (medium voltage/low voltage) transformer substations in the distribution network, with information on installed power and usage percentage. Fields that make up the dataset: Installation Code: Unique identifier of the distribution substation. Installed Power [kVA]: Represents the total power installed at the substation. Coverage: Portugal. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Electrical Network, Electric Mobility. Its keywords are homepage. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
